verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI agents that categorize spend and write expense memos (brex-docs-41, brex-docs-23). Its audit agent monitors expenses against internal processes and ranks potential violations by risk level (brex-docs-15), while a review agent auto-approves low-risk items and escalates exceptions (brex-docs-16). Receipts are fetched and automatically matched to expenses (brex-docs-23, brex-docs-7, brex-docs-27). missing for 10: explicit duplicate-expense or fraud detection (the audit agent covers policy violations only), evidence of AI reading itemized receipt content for expenses rather than just matching, independent or hands-on corroboration.
